basic_profile.bio: A dedicated gamer and digital artist living in the Pacific Northwest. I have a deep passion for medieval-themed games and love exploring the intricacies of digital design in my free time. A self-taught graphic designer, I’ve been working freelance for the last five years. I dislike cluttered interfaces and overly complex game mechanics. I'm usually active online late at night, often while winding down after a day of client work or gaming. Currently single and enjoying the freedom to travel and work remotely.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in digital design, which I mostly learned through online courses and practice. My interest in technology and gaming has also led me to become knowledgeable in areas like game mechanics and user interface design.
